brief:
An Israeli airstrike struck a house in the Al-Sabra neighborhood of Gaza City, leaving an elderly Palestinian man so severely injured that he crawled along the ground in the aftermath, Eye on Palestine reported. A journalist documenting the attack's destruction discovered him struggling to move amid the rubble.

The strike occurred as Israeli bombardments continue across Gaza, with civilians including elderly residents facing difficulty evacuating during attacks.
dek: An injured elderly Palestinian man crawls along the ground after an Israeli airstrike targeted a house in the Al-Sabra neighborhood of Gaza City. A journalist documenting the aftermath of the attack discovered him struggling to move amid the destruction.
title: Israeli airstrike on Gaza City leaves elderly Palestinian man severely injured
